structure_proposals.why: Overhead cable triceps is the identical three sets of 10 to 12 on both push days, and you ran it at 55 pounds on 8 September and again on 55 pounds on 14 September, finishing on 9 reps both nights — under the bottom of the range both times — so this takes Push B to 8 to 10 and lets the two push days stop being the same set, the way your chest press already splits 10 to 12 on Push A and 8 to 10 on Push B.
